The intruder, who began breaking in a month ago, apparently is not a thief, but leaves gifts for her. The three of them head to her apartment and discover a suitcase with a ribbon on it in the entryway. Believing it is a new gift from the intruder, Kogoro opens the suitcase and finds a dead body packed inside...

videos.title: 'Til Death Do Us Part
videos.overview: Conan and Kogoro are attending a wedding. Kogoro met the groom's father at a bar where he's a regular and ended up receiving an invitation. Also attending the wedding are staff including the wedding planner and priest, as well as the couple's friends. The ceremony begins, and just as the bride enters the chapel, she begins choking and loses consciousness. Upon seeing her pain, the people in attendance say ominous things such as "she got what she deserved" and "this wedding was cursed."

videos.title: The Shopping Center in Love
videos.overview: Kogoro and Conan pass by a lonely shopping street. They try to shop at a greengrocer that catches their eyes, but the owner, Yoshinobu Yamazaki, seems to be in a bad mood. Madam Gaga, a TV producer who revitalizes the exhausted shopping district, and her assistant, Rabbit Suzuki, came there. Madam calls out: "Let's hold a professional wrestling tournament to liven up the shopping district!" The shopkeepers of the shopping district train their bodies through various trainings, and Kogoro will also participate as a referee.

videos.title: Tsuburaya Mitsuhiko's Detective Notes
videos.overview: Conan, Haibara, Ayumi, Genta, and Mitsuhiko arrive at a takeout pizza restaurant. They participate in the store's campaign to guess the weight of a ball of pizza dough, and thanks to Genta, they win a free pizza. After splitting the pizza into fifths and placing their slices inside special boxes, they head home. On their way, all of them have their pizza stolen by someone. When the kids meet back up, each one has a torn pizza box. Conan and Mitsuhiko realize based on the damage that the culprit was after their boxes.

videos.title: The Sweet Voice Heard Through the Phone
videos.overview: The Mori Detective Agency receives a phone call from client Nagamine Mayako. Mayako has an appointment at the agency office, but she seems to have gotten lost. Though it's past her scheduled appointment time, Kogoro, who knows from her social media photos that Mayako is beautiful, seems excited. The client noticed her husband has been acting suspiciously and would like him to investigate the possibility that he is involved in criminal activity. Kogoro continues waiting for a while, but Mayako never shows up, and the agency receives another phone call...

videos.title: The Surprise That Leads to Tragedy
videos.overview: While on their way home from visiting Professor Agasa's friend's apartment, Conan, Ayumi, Mitsuhiko, and Genta hear a scream. They rush to the scene, where they discover a man bleeding from the head as well as a woman. The woman who lives at the apartment noticed something off about the place when she came home and grabbed the golf club she kept for self-defense. The lights wouldn't turn on, and as she entered the apartment, she heard a loud noise... The police confirm her story and believe it was an unfortunate accident. However, certain elements of the case catch Conan's attention...

videos.title: Kudo Yusaku's Detective Show (Part One)
videos.overview: Yusaku is approached by a TV reporter when he exits the Metropolitan Police Department. He's asked if he visited the police to confirm that the false charges against Kaito Kid had been dropped. However, Yusaku responds that his assistance was requested with the series of locked room murders that recently took place. He announces that he has solved the cases and will reveal the solution on a live broadcast over the weekend and even leaves a message for Kid before he departs. However, Yusaku runs into trouble on the day of the broadcast!

videos.title: Kudo Yusaku's Detective Show (Part Two)
videos.overview: Three victims who seem to share nothing in common are discovered within locked rooms in the serial locked room murder case. Yusaku's advice was requested by the Metropolitan Police Department, and he was scheduled to solve the case on live TV, but he ends up sick in bed with food poisoning. Yukiko, who was going to disguise herself as him and appear in his place, gets sick as well. Conan hears the doorbell ring and goes to open the door to the Kudo family home to turn down the TV appearance but comes face to face with Yusaku, who should be sick in bed...?! Kudo Yusaku's unrehearsed and unprepared detective show begins!

videos.title: The Detective Boys' Pursuit of the Purse-Snatcher
videos.overview: Ayumi runs into a purse-snatcher and the man pursuing them, Kume Shosaku. The other Detective Boys arrive, and while they're being filled in, a body is discovered in the apartment complex the culprit fled into. Next to the body are the jacket the culprit was wearing and the bag they stole. However, the money is missing from inside the bag, and the dead man doesn't look like the culprit. Meanwhile, Inspector Megure receives a call that the body of a man who has Kume's wallet and 300,000 yen has been discovered.

videos.title: The Boiled Fugu Mystery Tour Showdown (Mojiko & Kura Part)
videos.overview: Conan, Ran, and Kogoro are invited to visit Shimonoseki by the lawyer Oi, who they previously met during the inheritance dispute case. The clients are the fourth generation owner Izumiya Makoto and his daughter Kaede, who run the long-established fugu restaurant Izumiya. A thief entered their house while the restaurant was busiest and no one was home and stole their family's treasured cooking pot. While the pot is valuable, to the family, its true worth is in the broth that's seeped into the pot since the restaurant's founding. Conan and his companions question the four suspects identified by Oi's investigation, but...

videos.title: The Boiled Fugu Mystery Tour Showdown (Shimonoseki Part)
videos.overview: The lawyer Oi sends Conan, Ran, and Kogoro are sent to Izumiya, a long-established fugu restaurant in Shimonoseki, and are hired to find the family's stolen treasured cooking pot. During their investigation, Kogoro comes into contact with a suspicious person in the city at night. Once he's alone, they tell him to mind his own business and attack him. Is his attacker one of the four suspects they questioned during their investigation? Conan visits their restaurants to speak with them again and taste the dishes they pride themselves on.

videos.title: The Charismatic CEO's Secret Plan
videos.overview: Conan and Kogoro discover a body in a busy downtown area. The victim died instantly when he was struck on the head with a metal pipe, and there's a dying message in the street. They visit the victim's apartment, where the property manager tells them he said he'd pay all the rent he owed as early as the next day. The Utagawa Corporation CEO enters the picture when the manager describes how the victim reacted to the magazine he was reading the day of the murder, introducing the possibility that the victim was killed for attempting to blackmail the CEO...

videos.title: The Black Organization's Scheme (Hunt)
videos.overview: For several days, pairs of unidentified foreigners have been turning up dead. While discussing the case on their way home from school, Conan, Genta, Mitsuhiko, Ayumi, and Haibara come across a foreigner who has fallen off a building. When Conan sees Vodka on the roof, he instructs Haibara to take the three kids and leave the scene. Conan discovers an FBI ID and phone displaying a coded message on the fallen foreigner and heads to the Kudo family home, where he finds a gathering of FBI agents.

videos.title: The Black Organization's Scheme (Landing)
videos.overview: For several days, the Black Organization has been killing FBI agents. Conan and the FBI deduce that the Organization must be deciphering the FBI's coded messages, so they decide to use it against them by laying a trap for them. Supposedly dead Camel and Mark, the older brother of a killed agent, are chosen to go to the meeting location. However, no one arrives at the location indicated by the code, and shots are fired on the agents keeping watch. Will Camel be able to evade the Black Organization without them realizing he's still alive?!

videos.title: The Black Organization's Scheme (Identity)
videos.overview: Cornered by the Black Organization the FBI were trying to trap, Camel drives his car into the ocean. He manages to escape to Umizaru Island, where he warms up at the campsite. However, his location is given away when they spot his fire. The Black Organization arrives on the island in order to kill Camel and get a look at his face. In order to evade them, Camel acquires coffee bean bags and straws from the cafe on the island as instructed by Akai, but... How will the Black Organization's battle against the FBI over Agent Camel end?!

videos.title: The Cameras Targeting Haibara
videos.overview: Ayumi, Genta, and Mitsuhiko invite Conan and Haibara to the Beika department store. They have their sights set on the department store lottery's grand prize, a Hachijo-jima whale watching tour. The professor asks Haibara to withdraw some cash for him, so she heads to the bank's ATM. However, Kogoro arrived just before her, and his card has been swallowed by the machine. On their way to another branch, they spot a suspicious man in a black coat. He appears shocked when he sees Haibara, and then...

videos.title: My Beloved Dog Pan-kun Is a Good Boy
videos.overview: While playing at the park, Conan, Genta, Mitsuhiko, Ayumi, and Haibara hear a dog barking loudly and a woman screaming. They head to the location of the sound, where they find housewife Yamada Sachiko and her beloved dog Pan being attacked by a man wearing a ski mask. Rather than rescuing his owner, Pan flees during the commotion. With help from Conan and the kids, Sachiko escapes danger. Sachiko, who doesn't know why she was attacked, heads home with Pan once he returns, but Conan and the kids are curious about the masked man's goals and decide to investigate.

videos.title: The Alley of Sad Betrayal
videos.overview: Conan and Kogoro are enjoying a meal at an Italian bar in an alley while chatting with the owner Yamaura when the wall is suddenly demolished. The culprit is Kusumi, the owner of the alley, who has been harassing shop owners who refuse to vacate the alley. One shop owner even died from the stress. Sushi restaurant owner Fumio and creative cuisine restaurant owner Yonezawa arrive when they hear the commotion, and with their help, they successfully run off Kusumi. But when Kogoro visits the bathroom a while later, he discovers someone inside...

videos.title: Behind the Scenes of the J League Finals
videos.overview: Kawasaki Frontale takes on FC Tokyo in the J League 30th anniversary match. Conan and the Detective Boys have fun participating in the special event. However, once the event ends and they return to their seats, for some reason Haibara is in a bad mood. She wanted to enter the pitch holding hands with her favorite player Higo of Big Osaka, but she showed up on the wrong day. Haibara expresses her disappointment over her team's loss and Sanada's poor play... only to realize Sanada is standing right next to her! While watching the match together, Haibara notices something odd in the stands.

videos.title: The Freezing Cold Men
videos.overview: Conan, Ran, and Kogoro encounter some men arguing at the hospital. They are Ryoichi and Reiji, the sons of Kenzo, president of Aizawa foods, and senior executive director Bando. Kenzo, who is inside the treatment room, is the cause of their argument. The three men begin telling Kogoro about the circumstances when Kenzo collapsed in the refrigerated warehouse when the doctor finishes treating Kenzo. Kenzo, who is now awake, tells the others that he simply fell asleep from exhaustion. However, Conan senses there is something off about Kenzo's words and behavior.

videos.title: The Inauspicious Matchmaking (Part One)
videos.overview: Kazuha is visiting Tokyo, and Conan and Ran join her on a trip to Haido Shrine, which is said to provide matchmaking benefits. Because today is a lucky day, the shrine grounds are crowded with people. Ran, who wasn't aware the shrine was a popular spot, asks Kazuha how she learned about it. She apparently learned about the shrine through Heiji when she happened to see him looking it up on his phone. Based on his recent behavior, Conan realizes Heiji must be here as well and goes after the suspicious man wearing a fox man he spots. Meanwhile, Kazuha notices someone in the crowd who doesn't seem interested in matchmaking...

videos.title: The Inauspicious Matchmaking (Part Two)
videos.overview: Conan and Ran are invited to Haido Shrine by Kazuha, where they meet Heiji wearing a fox mask. The four of them get caught up in the murder that takes place there. The victim is Hidaka, an investigative police officer, who was looking at flashcards of mugshots of wanted criminals. Believing Hidaka was pursuing wanted criminals at the shrine, Conan and Heiji contact Detective Takagi, who finds three wanted criminals among the shrine visitors. Each criminal has a reason for remaining at the shrine and seems to have been aware of Hidaka's presence...

videos.title: The Case of Ayumi's Illustrated Diary 3
videos.overview: While on their way to go shopping, Conan and the Detective Boys hear a man scream. They head towards the sound, which brings them to a tanning salon. Inside the building is salon employee Tsunoda Yasuo, who informs them that there is a dead body in the third room from the back. They head down the dark hallway and find the body of Nishitani Shin inside a tanning machine. He is a bodybuilder with tanning gel rubbed all over his body in order to achieve an even tan. The police arrive, and according to their investigation, the gel was poisoned...

videos.title: The Unfortunate and Suspicious Victim
videos.overview: While passing by Doterasu Shrine in Beika City, the Detective Boys hear a scream and rush to the scene. They find Jupita on the ground, who struck his head after falling down the stone steps. Jupita is taken to the hospital and is likely to survive. Jupita's older sister and rising songwriter Juria and her mentor Saimon meet the Detective Boys at the hospital. Just before being attacked by a mugger, Jupita called Juria to tell her he was in another town. The Detective Boys begin investigating why Jupita lied about coming to Beika City.

videos.title: The Genius Restaurant
videos.overview: Conan and the Detective Boys arrive at a newly opened candy store. Chindon-ya is playing, and plums are handed out, perhaps in celebration. For the first time, the Detective Boys are obsessed with sweets, but Conan doesn't seem interested. Genta gets angry at Conan and says "You're acting like an adult!" The two get into a fight, and Conan decides to go home alone. On the way, an old gentleman jumps out of the alley and asks for help, saying, "I saw the dead omelet rice!"

videos.title: The Culprit Who Disappeared into the Sleeping Town
videos.overview: Kogoro, Ran, and Conan are walking down a deserted street when the request is over, and they hear the sound of horns and screams. There, they find Goro Nezu, a security guard who has been stabbed in the stomach with a knife. Pointing at the main street, Nezu says "white clothes" and dies. In addition, on the stairs where Nezu seems to have fallen, there is a screaming Keiko Yuki and the bodies of her husband Hideto Yuki, the president of an IT company. When Conan heads down the main street to hunt down the criminal, he finds a young man in a "black suit".

videos.title: Girls Day Mystery
videos.overview: In Professor Agasa's house, after rejecting Ran's invitation for shopping at the Beika Department Store, Conan sat on top of the sofa, and was watching a TV drama named "Flying Squir Murders", while urging Agasa to tag along. Agasa brought some pizza and they began to watch the TV drama.

videos.title: Stakeout 2
videos.overview: After seeing a window with open blinds, Conan, Haibara, and the Detective Boys discovered Takagi and Chiba were on another stakeout. Their goal was also to observe the building across from them.

videos.title: Miyano Akemi's Time Capsule (Part One)
videos.overview: Conan, Haibara, Ayumi, Genta, and Mitsuhiko visit Teitan Elementary School to take care of the rabbits. The man they encounter there sees Haibara and asks if she's Miyano Akemi's younger sister Shiho. His question frightens Haibara, but he is Teitan Elementary School graduate Murata Sho. His former classmates Yanagimachi Gaku and Ichihashi Seiko join him, and Conan and the Detective Boys learn Akemi attended Teitan Elementary School. The graduates planned to dig up the time capsule they buried when they graduated, but only Akemi knew where it was buried...

videos.title: Miyano Akemi's Time Capsule (Part Two)
videos.overview: While taking care of the rabbits at the animal shed, Conan, Haibara, Ayumi, Genta, and Mitsuhiko meet Teitan Elementary School graduates Murata Sho, Yanagimachi Gaku, and Ichihashi Seiko. They've been asked to dig up a time capsule while the rest of their class prepares for the class reunion. Akemi, the only person who knows the location of the buried time capsule, left behind a code, and the Detective Boys work with the graduates to find clues. But something strange happens during the search, and Conan believes someone may be interfering with their search for the time capsule.

videos.title: The Missing Man's Dream
videos.overview: Nakajima Takako visits the Mori Detective Agency and explains that her husband is missing. She lost contact with him three days ago, and the police aren't taking her concerns seriously. Conan and Kogoro begin examining the husband's personal effects they received from Takako. Among his belongings are photos from their honeymoon, of her husband diving with his coworker and a ship's captain, and her husband posing with his younger brother in front of their parents' home. They find nothing remarkable on the husband's computer, so they visit his workplace, but...

videos.title: Tsuburaya Mitsuhiko's Detective Notes 2
videos.overview: Conan, Ayumi, Genta, Mitsuhiko, and Haibara help out at the mini bird park of park administrator Kimishima Tomoshi. With the help almost over, Kimijima asks them to find the owner of the lost baseball cap. Conan and others found Katsumi Wang's home based on the clues left in the hat. The police officer there who was on patrol for burglaries warned Katsumi to pay attention. After hearing this, Conan and others decided to investigate the matter.

videos.title: Did I Do It?
videos.overview: A man with bloody clothes came to the Mouri Detective Agency - Manabu Sako. Yesterday, Sako had a lot of unpleasant things happen to him. He went out drinking alone and lost his memory in the middle of the day. When he woke up, his glasses were broken and his clothes were covered in blood. Because he had a pimple on my head, he knew it was someone else’s blood. So he wondered if he had done something big, so he came to ask for help. Although it was thought that there were no clues, Conan found clues from the smell of alcohol in his body...

videos.title: Hagiwara Chihaya, Goddess of the Wind (Part One)
videos.overview: Ran, Kogoro, and Sonoko arrive at a popular restaurant. Conan and Professor Agasa join them inside after showing up late, where they are greeted by Nanjo, president of Suzuki Security, in disguise. He has been receiving threats since he provoked the thieves who stole a safe the other day, and is feeling constrained by the bodyguards assigned to him. Later, Nanjo steps away to visit the restroom. Conan realizes the professor has been in the restroom for a long time, and when he goes to check on him...!

videos.title: Hagiwara Chihaya, Goddess of the Wind (Part Two)
videos.overview: While pursuing the culprits who mistakenly kidnapped the professor, Conan is rescued by Kanagawa police officer Hagiwara Chihaya. They pursue the yellow getaway vehicle on Chihaya's motorbike, but the detective badge they had been relying on is disposed of. The professor still has in his possession a listening device, and they use the sound heard through it alone to continue their pursuit...

videos.title: The Troublesome 20 Million Yen
videos.overview: Conan, Kogoro, and Ran visit the home of client Nemoto Eriko. Three months ago, Eriko lost her husband, Nemoto Yutaka, in a traffic accident. While going through his things, she found 20 million yen in the back of the closet. Believing it could be dirty money, Eriko hired Kogoro to determine where the money came from. Kogoro considers the possibilities of savings or lottery winnings but eventually begins investigating armed robberies that took place recently. They narrow down the list of possible cases and visit the victims.

videos.title: Pride of the Immortal Man
videos.overview: Conan and Kogoro discover the body of Tsukuba Corporation president Tsukuba. He died after falling from the roof of a building, and a mysterious message was inside his pocket. When they visit his office to gather information, the employees respond to the message's words, "third time's the charm". Tsukuba was attacked twice over the span of several days. Just as the police decide to investigate the death as a successful attack by the culprit, Tsukuba's aunt shows up and says she received a call suggesting it might be a suicide. The police begin investigating the death as both a murder and suicide, but...

videos.title: Akabeko and the Three Lucky Men
videos.overview: Conan, Ran, and Sonoko visited an exhibition by an up-and-coming artist, Motoko Bekobe. Motoko has been releasing avant-garde works that combine traditional akabe with modern art, and are evidently attracting further attention across the globe. The three of them first saw a ceremony in the New Beika Modern Art Museum, there were several men dancing, wearing loincloths, cheering up for the big day. They constantly uttered the peculiar motto "Akabeko Bekoe", hinting everyone about Bekobe's success.

videos.title: The Teen Novel That Smells Like Guilt
videos.overview: This time, Kogoro took over an unusual affair, from a well-known novelist who specialises in teen novels particularly, named Chu Masamura. He requested Kogoro to investigate regarding a deceased, who is called Taizo Yasuki, who died recently during a car accident. He persistantly emphasised his need, to ascertain all of the late Yasuki's friends and acquaintances, especially those "questionable" ones.

videos.title: The True Culprit Is on the Run
videos.overview: While playing in the park, Conan and the Detective Boys find a man's body in the bushes. According to the police, the man is Takamatsu Jiro, who worked in a nearby building as a moneylender, leading them to believe the murder may have been an armed robbery or related to money troubles. The blood on the rock used to kill him suggests the culprit is covered in blood. The children, who were in the park the whole time, didn't see anyone suspicious, and the trail of bloody footprints they find ends abruptly.

videos.title: Kid vs. Amuro: Queen's Bang (Part One)
videos.overview: Conan, Ran, and Sonoko visit the Robanov imperial treasures exhibit. The highlight of the exhibition is a tiara set with the world's largest garnet passed down from queen to queen, known as the Queen's Bang. Because Kaito Kid has declared his intent to steal the tiara, a long line has formed at the exhibition. They find Amuro and Azusa in line, and they decide to wait in line together. While waiting, at Azusa's suggestion, Amuro performs a magic trick to kill time, but...

videos.title: Kid vs. Amuro: Queen's Bang (Part Two)
videos.overview: The Queen's Bang tiara, the centerpiece of the Robanov imperial treasures exhibit, is stolen by Kaito Kid! The exhibition hall is suddenly enveloped in white smoke, and by the time it has cleared, the tiara inside the case has vanished. Because a gas mask would ruin his disguise, it's unlikely Kaito Kid was wearing one. The suspects are narrowed down to Amuro, Azusa, and Kazami, who were standing near the tiara without masks, so Conan decides to investigate.

videos.title: I Was Set Up
videos.overview: Conan and Kogoro visit the home of real estate company manager Sanada on a job. However, Sanada says he no longer needs his help and offers him a cancellation fee. Sanada's eagerness for them to leave leads Kogoro to question him, and Sanada begins explaining that he never intended to kill anyone. Three days earlier, Sanada's real estate office was visited by a man named Inumaru. Blackmailed over wrongdoings he never committed, Sanada asked his friend Kawakatsu for advice, but then something happened.

videos.title: The Secret Hidden by the Cards
videos.overview: Within a certain bookstore, the Detective Boys were playing trading cards - Mitsuhiko was having a confrontation with Genta. While they were playing, Conan, Haibara, Ayumi, and Professor Agasa were watching nearby. On the other side of the table stood two mystical people... also watching their games in silence.

videos.title: Takagi and Date and the Notebook Promise (Part One)
videos.overview: Conan, Ayumi, Genta, Mitsuhiko, and Haibara visit Professor Agasa while he's sick in the hospital. On their way home, they happen upon Detective Takagi chasing down a robber. Detective Sato arrives from another direction to execute a pincer move on the robber, who is successfully apprehended. When Detective Takagi opens his police notebook to note the time of arrest, he notices the code written there by Detective Date, who passed away in a traffic accident one year ago. Thinking he may be able to decipher it, Conan reviews the code, which leads them to...

videos.title: Takagi and Date and the Notebook Promise (Part Two)
videos.overview: Conan, Ayumi, Genta, Mitsuhiko, Haibara, and Detectives Takagi and Sato decipher the code Detective Date left in his notebook and arrive at café Poirot. They deduce the ransom handoff method described by the kidnapper based on information left at Poirot and successfully rescue Alan, the son of the vice president of a French car maker. The case seems resolved until they learn Alan was being held captive along with his friend Inukai Yuji. They must deduce the location where he is being held based on Alan's time in the car.

videos.title: Rube Goldberg Machine (Part One)
videos.overview: A job brings Conan, Ran, and Kogoro to a resort area in Gunma Prefecture, where they run into Inspector Yamamura investigating a case. Inoue Kohei was murdered by Rube Goldberg Machine, a device made up of a chain reaction of many simple gimmicks.

videos.title: Rube Goldberg Machine (Part Two)
videos.overview: When the contraption that was used to kill the victim is found, the falling chimney incident at the resort area Conan, Ran, and Kogoro were visiting is investigated as a homicide. Several of the victim's acquaintances are staying nearby, so they go to question them. The victim's wife, the company's president and CEO, an old friend and shareholder, an investor with whom the victim had a rocky relationship, and the victim's mistress are all suspects. They discover one of the suspects is rather knowledgeable about the type of device found at the villa and becomes the prime suspect, but...

videos.title: Last Dinner for You
videos.overview: Conan, Ran, and Kogoro come across an Italian restaurant on fire. A nearby man rushes inside the building. In an attempt to stop him, Kogoro follows him inside, where he discovers a body. The police investigation identifies the victim as Head Chef Marcello. The man who rushed into the building was Akiyama the waiter. Later, the owner Kurasaka, his daughter Mariko, and the victim's wife Arisa arrive. The police believe a burglar broke into the closed restaurant and ran into the victim while he was cooking, but...

videos.title: The Holed-Up Sensation
videos.overview: A man armed with a gun shows up in a residential neighborhood. He takes a woman hostage and holes up inside a nearby home. Conan and Kogoro rush to the scene after seeing the situation on TV. The police are confused by the culprit's nonsensical demands. The homeowner arrives and tells the police not to worry about breaking down doors or walls since the home is vacant and will be demolished the next day. While they're talking outside, two gunshots are heard from inside the house...

videos.title: Chihaya and Jugo's Matchmaking Party (Part One)
videos.overview: Conan, Ran, and Kogoro are refused entry to a restaurant, privatized that day to host a masked party for singles. Participating in this event, Inspector Yokomizo meets Chihaya, and both will be confronted with a murder...

videos.title: Chihaya and Jugo's Matchmaking Party (Part Two)
videos.overview: Faced with a murder committed during a singles' masked party, the police try to find the culprit among three suspects. Nothing conclusive emerges from their interrogation, but Conan notices an important detail...

videos.title: Karate Teacher, Ran Mouri
videos.overview: Ran steps in as a temporary karate instructor when the dojo's regular instructor is injured. Just as the class is ending, a scream is heard from the second floor.

videos.title: Girls Day Mystery 2
videos.overview: While the boys relax at a hot spring, the girls happen to meet up at a snowy mountain resort. They are enjoying their day together when they discover that strange pranks have been happening at the resort.

videos.title: The Four-Person Class Reunion
videos.overview: Detective Kogoro is asked to be the bodyguard of the owner of a high-end host club. On the first day of his duties, he finds the owner dead in his own pool. It looks like one of the members of his annual four-person class reunion may be responsible.

videos.title: The Lost Treasure Mystery
videos.overview: Conan accompanies Sonoko to the studio of a famous potter. While there, Conan discovers that one of his pottery pieces has been broken, and worse, that the piece was already sold! It will take Conan's skills in deductive reasoning to figure out the culprit.

videos.title: The Dangerous Melon Field
videos.overview: Detective Kogoro is asked to investigate the damages and theft of a melon farmer's crops. While at the farm, there are several mysteries they will have to solve...

videos.title: Stakeout 3
videos.overview: The kids assist Detective Takagi in trying to catch a murderer. They have to stakeout a bakery to try to find the culprit. Can they focus on solving the crime instead of focusing on pastries and sweets from the bakery?

videos.title: The Body on the Gunma-Nagano Border (Part One)
videos.overview: Detective Kogoro, Ran, and Conan are in Gunma after solving a missing persons case when Detective Mori calls Detective Yamamura. Detective Yamamura asks Detective Mori for help with a murder that took place directly on the border between Gunma and Nagano.

videos.title: The Body on the Gunma-Nagano Border (Part Two)
videos.overview: Detective Yamamura's past holds a key to solving the mystery of the murder on the border between Gunma and Nagano. With the best detectives on the scene, can they solve this murder mystery? Did the victim leave any clues behind?

videos.title: The Case of Ayumi's Illustrated Diary 4
videos.overview: Ayumi is tired of so many peaceful days in a row and enlists the help of the Detective Boys to hunt for a case. Unfortunately, when one goes looking for trouble, that is exactly what they usually find.

videos.title: The Detective Who Lost His Mind
videos.overview: Detective Kogoro is called upon by a beautiful client. Fortunately, Ran sends Conan with her father, since she knows he has a penchant for being blinded by pretty women.

videos.title: Interrogation Room 2
videos.overview: A former grade school teacher confesses to committing a murder, but the more the police question him, the more questionable his testimony sounds.

videos.title: Conan and Megure's Two Hostages (Part One)
videos.overview: While at a bookstore, Conan stumbles upon a note from a child named Kazuo who's been kidnapped. Conan is able to switch places with Kazuo, but will he be able to outwit the kidnappers and escape himself?

videos.title: Conan and Megure's Two Hostages (Part Two)
videos.overview: Conan helps the married couple that kidnapped Kazuo, doing his best to make sure that their child, Tetsuya, is safely reunited with them. But what fate lays in wait for Kazuo?

videos.title: The Suspected Infidelity of the Triple Collab (Part One)
videos.overview: The Detective Boys are having lunch and talking about their favorite band, when they spot Kobayashi-sensei, Det. Chiba and Shukichi Haneda. Ayumi assumes they are on a triple date, but...

videos.title: The Suspected Infidelity of the Triple Collab (Part Two)
videos.overview: A poisoning occurs at the restaurant where Conan and the Detective Boys are dining, but without knowing how to plant the poison, the investigation grinds to a halt. Detective Kobayashi looks to Conan for advice.

videos.title: Tsuburaya Mitsuhiko's Detective Notes 3
videos.overview: At the venue for the "North American Flower Festival: Audition for the Role of the Lord," Mitsuhiko, Ayumi, and Genta encounter Makio Yuita and Kōzō Yuita, who are arguing. After Makio leaves, the remaining Kōzō explains that the two of them are brothers who happened to meet at the audition venue.

videos.title: Best Husband
videos.overview: Conan, Ran, and Kogoro visit the home of politician Reiko Mutsu. They are guided by her secretary, Shinji Inui, and wait inside the mansion, but Reiko doesn't appear for some time. Suddenly, Reiko's scream echoes through the mansion.

videos.title: Misfortune of the Positive Man
videos.overview: Conan and the Detective Boys become acquainted with a kind man named Shojichi Aida. While heading to Aida's apartment, they encounter a quarrel between his neighbor, Nenji Kotakara, and the landlord, Teruyo Imaizumi.

videos.title: Ooka Momiji's Sweet Trap (Part One)
videos.overview: A stage play modeled after Kogoro and Heiji is being planned, and Conan and the others have come to Kyoto for a meeting. When they visit the director's home, they find the producer, stage manager, and scriptwriter there.

videos.title: Ooka Momiji's Sweet Trap (Part Two)
videos.overview: Conan, Kogoro, and Heiji are at the home of the director, Kabumoto, for a meeting about a stage play. Present are also Momiji Ooka, who claims to be Heiji's fiancée, and Hyoe Kuroda, an officer from the Metropolitan Police Department.

videos.title: The Secret of the Popular Restaurant's Changing Flavor
videos.overview: The Detective Boys are distressed to discover the flavor of popular ramen shop Ogataken's flavor has changed, so they head to the restaurant to investigate.

videos.title: The Moving Police Box
videos.overview: The Detective Boys help with the unveiling of a mobile police box car. While the vehicle is touring around, it is hijacked by some robbers, and everyone onboard is taken hostage.

videos.title: The Sister Troubled by Her Naughty Brother
videos.overview: Shigatsu Makabe comes to the Mouri Detective Agency with a request after malicious flyers were posted on his apartment condominium. Kogoro, who was conducting surveillance at the condominium, apprehends a suspicious young man, but... a few days later, a body is found in a unit of a luxury condominium.

videos.title: Girls Day Mystery 3
videos.overview: The "Five Female Detectives" a.k.a Ran, Sonoko, Haibara, Ayumi and Detective Sato sense a suspicious high-paying part-time job advertisement that involves "dressing as ninjas and going to designated locations" to hint at a crime, and decide to go undercover to investigate.

videos.title: The Mouri Family House Sits
videos.overview: Kogoro receives a request from literary critic Takahiko Kamiyu to stay at his house while he goes to the countryside for three days. He plans to turn down the offer, as it doesn't seem like detective work, but for the high pay, all he has to do is look after the pet cat, and the only thing that bothers him is the noise from the construction work that starts on the second day. Kogoro accepts the favorable conditions, which include free use of alcohol and food in the house, and the right to invite Conan and Ran. However, while he is relaxing at the Kamiyu residence, one visitor after another begins to arrive...

videos.title: The Ranpo Mansion Murder Case (Part One)
videos.overview: The Detective Boys, including Conan, accompanied by their teacher Miss Kobayashi, visit the Rampo residence. The storehouse which Rampo used as library entailed a great deal of valuable books, stimulating the excitement of Conan and the rest. In the meantime, Detective Sato and Detective Takagi arrive, whereupon they are informed that a murder case has taken place in a nearby park. And - which is more - the victim's belongings seem to be related to the storehouse that was often closed to the public... The modern-day Detective Boys shall challenge this difficult case!

videos.title: The Ranpo Mansion Murder Case (Part Two)
videos.overview: While Conan and the Detective Boys are visiting the Edogawa Ranpo Residence with Kobayashi-sensei, a series of murders occur. Conan realizes the case isn't over yet and rushes to solve the crime before another victim can be killed, but the culprit is already closing in on their next target.

videos.title: The Hotel Serial Bombing Case (Part One)
videos.overview: Conan visits Sera's hotel room at the Haido Hotel, lured in by the code used in the hotel serial bombing case. However, they realize the hotel they're at is the bomber's next target when they happen to be present when the next bomb threat is discovered.

videos.title: The Hotel Serial Bombing Case (Part Two)
videos.overview: Invited by Sera, Conan visits the Haido Hotel, where he encounters a series of hotel bombings. With the help of the hotel's legal adviser, Kisaki Eri, who happens to be passing by, Conan and Sera obtain past codes and narrow down the rooms where the bombs are likely to be to six. The possible culprits are Moriko, a hotel cleaner, Kureishi, a bellboy, and Hayashizaki, a guest in the room where the code was placed. With the time limit until the explosion approaching, will Conan and Sera be able to track down the culprit?

videos.title: The Whistling Bookstore 4
videos.overview: While reading at Tamaki Book Cafe, the Detective Boys meet Komachi Ami, who accidentally sold a precious book that was a keepsake from her father.

videos.title: Stakeout 4
videos.overview: Conan and the Detective Boys come to an amusement park that is closing today. There, they find Detectives Takagi and Chiba disguised as security guards and holding out a stakeout.

videos.title: The Detective Boys and the Two Leaders (Part One)
videos.overview: Conan and the Detective Boys, accompanied by Professor Wakasa and Subaru Okiya, go to a beach in Shizuoka that is collaborating with Kamen Yaiba. Wakasa and Okiya meet and negotiate! Furthermore, an incident occurs at the beach house.

videos.title: The Detective Boys and the Two Leaders (Part Two)
videos.overview: Conan and the Detective Boys, who are accompanied by Professor Wakasa and Subaru Okiya to the beach, encounter a case. The victim is the manager of a beach house, and the suspects are the staff. Who is the culprit? And what is the relationship between Wakasa and Okiya?

videos.title: Kaitou Kid and the Crown Trick (Part One)
videos.overview: Jirokichi Suzuki of the Suzuki Zaibatsu receives a warning letter from Kaitou Kid. The target is the crown "Sea Witch's Water Spray", which is embedded with one of the world's largest tourmalines. However, Jirokichi is confident in his newly installed special passage "Fujin no Michi" to deal with Kid. It is the latest security device installed at the only entrance to the exhibition hall, and if the crown moves even a millimeter away, the entrance will be instantly blocked. With the warning time approaching, will Conan, who has been called upon as the Kid killer again, be able to capture the Reiwa magician?

videos.title: Kaitou Kid and the Crown Trick (Part Two)
videos.overview: Kid makes the Siren Splash crown vanish from its display case at the Suzuki building, but the alarm was never triggered. Just how did he do it?

videos.title: Last Dance
videos.overview: Conan and Ran are invited by Sonoko to a dance party held by real estate company manager Takada Kensaku. Kensaku's wife Konomi and many other celebrities are also in attendance. During the party, Kensaku gets into trouble and leaves his seat, never to return. Yamazato Rika, a maid who was searching for Kensaku at Konomi's instructions, discovers Kensaku's body after he fell off a cliff. Party attendees behaving suspiciously, unnatural footprints left behind... Was this an accident caused by the victim losing his footing, or was it a murder?

videos.title: The Yamahime of Yakushima (Part One)
videos.overview: Kogoro, Conan and Ran visit Yakushima in Kagoshima Prefecture. To investigate the case of a body being abandoned on Jomon Cedar, they head to Jomon Cedar accompanied by guide Kitabeppu Ayaya, who was the first person to discover the body. During the long and difficult climb, they hear the legend of the "Yamahime", a terrifying monster that sucks human blood.

videos.title: The Yamahime of Yakushima (Part Two)
videos.overview: Kogoro is certain the culprit is Tsukada, but Conan and Ran aren't so sure.

videos.title: Follow Them! Detective Taxi 2
videos.overview: Genki Ishikawa, a taxi driver who calls himself a "Kogoro Mori geek," comes to the detective agency. At the "Jewelry Washing Festival", Ishikawa spots a suspicious duo taking candid photos of the participants' cars. The diamond ring was not stolen and Ishikawa has disappeared. What is the purpose of the suspicious duo?

videos.title: Ishikawa Night Mystery (Part One)
videos.overview: Kogoro receives a request, and he travels to Kanazawa with Conan and Ran on the Hokuriku Shinkansen. However, Kogoro tries to meet the client alone. Conan plants a wiretap on Kogoro and decides to find out his movements while sightseeing in Kanazawa with Ran. The client is a beautiful woman, Arihara Yumeno, who serves as Kanazawa's public relations ambassador. She has received a threatening letter from an unknown sender that alludes to an unsolved theft case from three years ago, and has asked Kogoro to find out who the sender was and the truth behind the past incident. At the same time, Conan, who is listening to the wiretap, suddenly has a gun pointed at his head.

videos.title: Ishikawa Night Mystery (Part Two)
videos.overview: Kogoro is investigating an unsolved theft case from three years ago in the Ishikawa Prefecture when Conan is suddenly kidnapped during the investigation. The kidnapper demands that Kogoro gather the client, Yumeno Arihara, and his former band members. Meanwhile, Conan hears about the true intention of the kidnapper, Ryusei, and they're chased by someone when the brakes on their car are broken and they fall off a cliff...

videos.title: The Detective Boys and the Traditional Dream House
videos.overview: A married couple, Haga Akito and Haga Akari, move into an old house in Beika Town. Conan and the Detective Boys hit it off with the couple and decide to help them with some DIY work on the house. However, the couple accidentally make a hole in a brittle wall, and a skeleton emerges...!?

videos.title: The Whereabouts of the Goodbye
videos.overview: Kogoro's client is found dead in her apartment. The police suspect suicide, but Conan isn't so sure.

videos.title: When the Shishi-odoshi Sounds
videos.overview: Conan investigates Komada murder; a photo captures the killer’s strike but hides his face. Who is the culprit?

videos.title: The Secret's Afterimage
videos.overview: Inspector Megure comes to the Mouri Detective Agency with a request. He asks them to investigate his subordinate, Detective Sawatari, who is having an affair. While his wife is back at her parents house, he has been dining with another woman at a cafe frequented by couples, visiting a high-end jewelry shop, and buying a bouquet of flowers - circumstantial evidence seems to confirm the affair.

videos.title: The Case of Ayumi's Illustrated Diary 5
videos.overview: For her summer vacation independent study, Ayumi decides to film a documentary about the Mouri Detective Agency.  The subject of the film is a series of incidents of vandalism that occurred in the Beikacho shopping district. There is no danger as Kogoro has already solved the case. However, as Conan reflects on the incident, he notices something odd. What clue does Ayumi's picture diary offer this time?

videos.title: The Counting Song Heard in the Dark
videos.overview: When a valuable old coin is found at an inn, a man is murdered and the coin goes missing.

videos.title: The 17-Year-Old Truth: The Bloody Knight
videos.overview: Conan and his friends attend a chess tournament to show support for Inspector Shiratori.

videos.title: The 17-Year-Old Truth: The Perceptive Devil
videos.overview: While watching Conan solve the murder, Kuroda recalls an unsolved case from 17 years ago.

videos.title: The 17-Year-Old Truth: The Far-sighted Bishop
videos.overview: At a chess event, a case echoes a 17-year-old murder. Conan is asked to uncover the shadow behind it.

videos.title: The 17-Year-Old Truth: The Queen's Gambit
videos.overview: 17 years ago, Kuroda helped Asaka escape. Now, Rum sets his sights on a new target tied to the past.

videos.title: Genta's Casebook of the Eel
videos.overview: While Genta delivers food for an eel restaurant, the chef is stabbed in the chest.

videos.title: The Mystery of the Man-eating Classroom (Part One)
videos.overview: A rumor begins spreading at Teitan Elementary School about a man-eating classroom.

videos.title: The Mystery of the Man-eating Classroom (Part Two)
videos.overview: Conan identifies the culprit who started the fire that could cancel the class visit.

videos.title: The Reason He Became a Butler (Part One)
videos.overview: Heiji and Kazuha happen to find themselves on the same bullet train bound for Tokyo as Momiji and Iori.

videos.title: The Reason He Became a Butler (Part Two)
videos.overview: Momiji's butler Iori becomes involved in a murder on a train, and Momiji is taken hostage.

videos.title: It's a ghost!
videos.overview: The Detective Boys investigate a ghost that appears on the roof of a building every Thursday night.

videos.title: The Glassy Water's Surface (Part 1)
videos.overview: Kogoro is hired to investigate the mysterious death of a fisherman in a small town famous for its boathouses.

videos.title: The Glassy Water's Surface (Part 2)
videos.overview: One mysterious murder turns into two in a remote port town in Kyoto prefecture.

videos.title: The Hero of Ishinomaki
videos.overview: The Detective Boys go to Miyagi Prefecture to film an episode of Kamen Yaiba.

videos.title: Search for the Phantom Giant
videos.overview: The Detective Boys encounter Takagi and Chiba, who are looking for a tall man to verify a suspect's alibi.

videos.title: The Crimson Skull of Mount Washio (Part 1)
videos.overview: A sudden downpour forces Conan and his friends to seek shelter at a temple.

videos.title: The Crimson Skull of Mount Washio (Part 2)
videos.overview: The missing monk turns up dead, but Kogoro is still missing. Could it be the curse of the Crimson Skeleton?

videos.title: The Lucky Cat Saw Everything
videos.overview: While birdwatching, Conan, Ran, and Kogoro spot a suspicious man driving away from house with a body inside.

videos.title: Buchi Returns A Favor
videos.overview: "Buchi," who promised to provide information to Detective Takagi, is found dead. Using the memo left behind as a clue, Conan and the others stake out a jewelry store to stop a robbery.

videos.title: Arrest That Face
videos.overview: Ayumi sees a man with a face identical to one on a wanted poster.

videos.title: The Interrogation Room 3
videos.overview: A rising young actress admits to murdering her director but later recants her confession.

videos.title: The Red Brick Warehouse and the Vanishing Kidnapper (Part One)
videos.overview: Detectives Takagi and Sato pursue a kidnapper to the historic red-brick warehouse in Yokohama.

videos.title: The Red Brick Warehouse and the Vanishing Kidnapper (Part Two)
videos.overview: The kids decipher the Dice Man's code while the police pursue the culprit at the red-brick warehouse.

videos.title: Girls Day Mystery 4
videos.overview: The ladies meet at an all-you-can-eat cake buffet, and the women at a nearby table suddenly collapse.

videos.title: Episode "ZERO" Kudo Shinichi and the Aquarium Case
videos.overview: Before he became Conan, Shinichi and Ran's trip to the aquarium is derailed by a murder.

videos.title: Follow Them! Detective Taxi 3
videos.overview: Kogoro and Conan are invited to attend an event in Furai City as special guests.

videos.title: Double Alibi
videos.overview: Kogoro is hired by an up-and-coming clockmaker to investigate a threatening note.

videos.title: The Lover Who Vanished on Pont Koitani (Tottori Tour)
videos.overview: A waitress disappears from the ryokan where Conan, Ran, and Kogoro are staying at the Misasa Hot Springs.

videos.title: The Lover Who Vanished on Pont Koitani (Misasa Tour)
videos.overview: The missing lover's fake disappearance turns into a real kidnapping.

videos.title: Tsuburaya Mitsuhiko's Detective Notes 4
videos.overview: The Detective Boys come across a case reminiscent of "The Adventure of the Abbey Grange".

videos.title: Kid Vs. Hakuba: The Azure Throne (Part One)
videos.overview: Kaito Kid sneaks into the exhibition room to steal the Azure Throne only to discover a body sitting in it.

videos.title: Kid Vs. Hakuba: The Azure Throne (Part Two)
videos.overview: Hakuba, the disguised Kid, and Conan expose the murderer. But Hakuba harbors yet another suspicion…

videos.title: The Spiral Mansion Mystery (Part One)
videos.overview: A man is found dead at an art museum dedicated to spirals.

videos.title: The Spiral Mansion Mystery (Part Two)
videos.overview: A vanishing culprit, a secret room, and a second murder. Conan closes in on the center of the mystery.

videos.title: The Cosplay Rider of the Wind
videos.overview: The Detective Boys and a Kamen Yaiba impostor chase a serial purse snatcher on a motorcycle.

videos.title: Cinderella's shoe
videos.overview: Kogoro is hired by the heir of a business conglomerate to find his 'Cinderella'.

videos.title: The Detective Boys VS The Silver Detectives 2
videos.overview: A woman asks a group of senior detectives to find her missing husband.

videos.title: The Porch Pirate Epidemic
videos.overview: Kogoro is hired to catch a porch pirate.

videos.title: I Am The Culprit
videos.overview: Four people confess to committing the same murder, but none of them will explain how they did it.

videos.title: I Cannot Lie to Archery
videos.overview: Two brothers are suspected of murdering their father with a bow and arrow.

videos.title: Sonoko and Conan's Ghost Story Night
videos.overview: While staying at a mountain lodge, Conan and Sonoko stumble upon a masked figure burying a body. As the mysterious culprit gives chase, the two must find a way to escape.

videos.title: Who Kidnapped Conan and Azusa? (Part One)
videos.overview: Conan and Azusa ask Amuro for help after realizing they are being followed. But when a passing bus blocks the view, the two suddenly disappear.

videos.title: Who Kidnapped Conan and Azusa? (Part Two)
videos.overview: As the kidnapping of Conan and Azusa continues, clues at their hideout point to a connection with a shocking serial crime. Can Amuro and the high school girl trio uncover the culprit before it's too late?

videos.title: The Man Who Came Falling Down
videos.overview: Conan and Kogoro, searching for something, stumble upon a man falling down a flight of stone steps. According to witnesses, the man was seen committing the crime at the top of the steps and lost his footing while trying to escape...

videos.title: The J League Opening Whistle
videos.overview: The Detective Boys go to watch the J.League opener, but there's a bomb somewhere inside the stadium.

videos.title: Welcome to the Stone Age Village
videos.overview: Conan, Ran, and Kogoro visit a town famous for its Stone Age heritage, only to discover a murder in the mountains and a mysterious figure dressed like a prehistoric man fleeing the scene.

videos.title: Who's the Target?
videos.overview: Conan and Kogoro find themselves in a race against time to determine who or what the culprit poisoned.

videos.title: The Cursed Neighbor's House
videos.overview: A woman demands that her family move away because their neighbor's house is cursed.

videos.title: The Birdman Rally Bombing (Part One)
videos.overview: Kogoro goes to Lake Biwa to watch his alma mater participate in the Birdman Rally.

videos.title: The Birdman Rally Bombing (Part Two)
videos.overview: Conan helps the pilot stay aloft to avoid triggering the explosion, while Heiji helps rescue the designer.

videos.title: Witness, Ran Mouri
videos.overview: While waiting to meet Sonoko, Ran is asked to be a haircut model. Just as she is about to head to the salon, she witnesses someone collapse by a window in a building across the train tracks and road.

videos.title: The Crimson Closing Day (Opening Day)
videos.overview: Heiji decides to tell Kazuha how he feels after watching a stage play based on himself and Kogoro.

videos.title: The Crimson Closing Day (The Penultimate Show)
videos.overview: Actors successively fall to their deaths at a theater in Osaka. Heiji, who had decided to confess his feelings to Kazuha at Naniwa Harukas, begins an investigation with Conan, but... The tragedy caused by the demon of ỈỈ was only the beginning.

videos.title: The Crimson Closing Day (The Final Show)
videos.overview:
As the serial murder case by “The Fiendish Puppeteer” reach its final act, Kazuha heads to Naniwa Harukas at Heiji’s invitation. 
The crimson sunset illuminates the stage as both the case and Heiji’s confession approach their grand finale…

videos.title: The Hands Pushing Their Back
videos.overview: A man comes to the Mouri Detective Agency with a request for help, claiming his fiancée's life is in danger. The culprit, who is threatening the fiancée, wants to force her to call off the wedding. Conan becomes wary of a certain person...

videos.title: Girls Day Mystery 5 (Part one)
videos.overview: A detective's body is discovered at a wedding venue. What was he investigating? Conan and Kogoro, who agree to help with the investigation, find something in the ransacked detective agency.
